product_overview: SinalizaExpress is a mobile-first PWA for planning, documenting, and sharing temporary traffic signage for road works. It helps field teams choose a work location, define required materials, draw a simple site sketch, and keep inventory and history records locally.
core_goals: Select and confirm the work location for a signage plan
Build a checklist of required traffic signage items and notes
Draw a visual croqui of the work area and export it for the report
Review the completed work summary and share it with others
Track signage inventory across stock, field use, and returns
Store completed works in history and return items back to available stock

features.name: Location Selection (Map)
features.description: Lets the user define the work location by placing it on a map, using the device location, or searching for an address.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Place a location pin on the map -> Review the selected address -> Proceed to the checklist
Navigate to / -> Use the device location -> Review the selected address -> Proceed to the checklist
Navigate to / -> Search for an address -> Select a suggested result -> Review the selected address -> Proceed to the checklist

features.name: Signaling Checklist
features.description: Lets the user choose the signaling items needed for the job, adjust quantities, add custom signs, and write operational notes.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Adjust item quantities up or down -> Add technical observations -> Continue to the summary
Navigate to / -> Open custom sign management -> Enter a custom sign name and description -> Add the new sign -> Adjust its quantity in the checklist -> Continue to the summary
Navigate to / -> Reduce an item quantity below zero -> See the quantity remain invalid or blocked

features.name: Croqui Drawing Board
features.description: Provides an interactive drawing canvas for placing roads, signs, vehicles, text, and other site elements, then exporting the sketch for the report.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select a drawing tool -> Place an element on the canvas -> Move or resize the element -> Undo the last action -> Save and continue
Navigate to / -> Select a drawing tool -> Place several elements on the canvas -> Rotate an element -> Delete the selected element -> Save and continue
Navigate to / -> Select a drawing tool -> Place elements on the canvas -> Clear the board -> Start a new layout -> Save and continue

features.name: Work Summary & Sharing
features.description: Shows the completed work details and lets the user save the operation to history, share the report, or start a new job.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Enter the responsible person's name -> Review the summary -> Save the work to history -> Share the report
Navigate to / -> Enter the responsible person's name -> Review the summary -> Share the report via the available sharing option
Navigate to / -> Enter the responsible person's name -> Review the summary -> Start a new job

features.name: Inventory Management
features.description: Lets the user review and maintain stock levels for signage items, including total stock and items currently in field use.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open inventory management -> Edit the total stock quantity for an item -> Review the updated stock balance
Navigate to / -> Open inventory management -> Add a new standard or custom item -> Review it in the inventory list
Navigate to / -> Open inventory management -> Remove an item that is not in use -> Review the updated inventory list

features.name: History & Returns
features.description: Lets the user review saved work plans, delete entries, and return signage items from a completed job back to stock.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open history -> Review a saved work plan -> Return the signage from that job -> See the stock update
Navigate to / -> Open history -> Delete a saved plan -> See the history list update

routes.description: Home page containing all main screens of SinalizaExpress (Map, Checklist, Croqui, Summary, History, Inventory) via stages.

features.name: Location Selection (Map)
features.description: Allow user to select the work location by dragging/tapping on the map, using GPS, or typing an address search.
user_interactions: Tapping/dragging map to place pin
Clicking Usar minha localizacao button to use GPS
Typing address in search bar and selecting result from Nominatim list
Clicking Avancar para Checklist to proceed

features.name: Signaling Checklist
features.description: Allow user to choose and quantify signaling items needed for the work, validating with inventory stock.
user_interactions: Clicking + or - buttons to modify quantities
Clicking Settings icon to manage custom signs
Typing new custom sign name and description, then clicking Adicionar Placa
Typing observations in text area
Clicking Resumo to proceed or Voltar to go to map

features.name: Croqui Drawing Board
features.description: Interactive canvas using react-konva where users can drag, rotate, scale, and place roadways, signs, vehicles, and text.
user_interactions: Selecting a tool from the top toolbar
Tapping/clicking on the canvas to place selected elements
Dragging placed elements to move them
Rotating or scaling elements using the Transformer anchor handles
Clicking Undo to revert last placement
Clicking Trash icon to clear the board
Clicking Excluir button to remove selected element
Clicking Salvar e Continuar to export canvas to PNG base64 and proceed

features.name: Work Summary & Sharing
features.description: Shows a summary of the work and allows sharing via WhatsApp or Web Share API.
user_interactions: Inputting responsible person name
Clicking Salvar no Historico button to commit inventory changes and log the work
Clicking Compartilhar button to share via Web Share API or WhatsApp Web/App
Clicking Nova Obra to clear state and restart

features.name: Inventory Management
features.description: Manage stock of signaling items, total stock, and items in use in field.
user_interactions: Accessing inventory view via package icon in header
Editing total stock quantity for items
Adding new standard or custom items to inventory
Removing items from inventory (if not in use)

features.name: History & Returns
features.description: Log of all saved signalization plans, showing details and allowing return of items back to stock.
user_interactions: Accessing history view via clipboard icon in header
Clicking Devolver sinalizacao to return all items of that work back to available stock
Clicking Trash icon to delete a plan from history log
